project.title: Proteome profile of Traf6-OE OT-I T cells
project.projectDescription: Proteome profile of Traf6-OE OT-I T cells and EV OT-I cells after viral transfection
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Naive OT-I T cells from OT-I mice were isolated and activated for 24 hours, and Traf6-OE or Vector viral were used to transfect T cells. Transfected T cells were analysis by proteome profile. Each group has three replicates
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Based on Raw files detected by mass spectrometry, 1) a sample specific protein database was constructed according to the source of samples, and then analysis software was used to search the database; 2) Quality control analysis of peptide and protein levels was conducted based on the database search results. 3) Annotated common functional databases of the identified proteins, including GO, KEGG, InterPro, COG and STRING databases; 4) Quantitative analysis of proteins, including quantitative distribution and repeatability analysis; 5) Conduct difference screening according to quantitative results, and draw relevant statistical charts for difference analysis
